postToolUse.bash: jq -r '.toolArgs | fromjson | .path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ] || exit 0; ( cd "$d" && uv run ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ); } || true
